Kit summary

Lunar FallBasic
Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 80% chance to inflict [Inferior Severe Wound] for 2 turns.
Lunar RadianceActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to reduce their SPD by 40% for 2 turns. Meanwhile, increases all allies' SPD by 20% for 2 turns.
Lunar Staff Lv.2Lunar Radiance: Increases the SPD bonus to 40%.
Lunar ShelterPassiveExclusive Lv.3
Reduces the Direct DMG taken by all allies by 12% when Guhanna survives. This effect is reduced by 50% 2 turns after Guhanna acts. When multiple skills increase this attribute, only the strongest one will take effect.
Lunar Staff Lv.3Lunar Shelter: Its effect will no longer be reduced by 50%.
Lunar RecoveryActiveExclusive Lv.1
Restores HP by 16% of Max HP for all allies and increases their Turn Meters by 20%. Meanwhile, increases all allies' ATK by 20% for 2 turns. The restoration effect is increased by 40% if the target's HP is no more than 50%.
Lunar Staff Lv.1Lunar Recovery: Also cleanses 5 layers of DoT debuffs from all allies.
